evals.prompt: `frontend` p99 storefront latency in `otel-demo` jumped from `~180ms` to over `5` seconds in the last 30 minutes while median p50 stayed near `190ms` after a `flagd` configuration rollout (`imageSlowLoad="5sec"`). Check our Tempo backend profile and investigate this tail latency regression against 1 hour ago.
evals.expected_output: Reads `tempo://server/capabilities` and `tempo://system/backends/default`, calls `tempo_analyze_service_red(service="frontend", since="30m", baseline_offset="1h")`, classifies the shape as bimodal long-tail (`p99 / p50 >= 5.0`), runs `tempo_compare_span_cohorts(base_query='{ resource.service.namespace = "otel-demo" && resource.service.name = "frontend" && kind = server }', selection='{ duration > 4s }')`, samples fast baseline vs slow `image-provider` (`:8081`) outlier traces, and runs `tempo_summarize_trace` + `tempo_compare_traces` to isolate `imageSlowLoad`.
expectations: Reads `tempo://system/backends/default` (and/or `tempo://server/capabilities`), calls `tempo_analyze_service_red` on `frontend` comparing against 1 hour ago, and identifies a bimodal tail spike (`p99 / p50 >= 5.0`)
Calls `tempo_compare_span_cohorts` to isolate attributes (`image-provider` / `imageSlowLoad` / `url.path`) skewed in the `> 4s` tail cohort
Samples representative fast and slow `otel-demo` traces via `tempo_get_exemplar_traces` or `tempo_traceql_search`
Runs `tempo_summarize_trace` and `tempo_compare_traces` before recommending resetting `imageSlowLoad` in `flagd`

evals.prompt: Compare fast baseline `recommendation` trace `11112222333344445555666677778888` (`140ms`, `recommendationCacheFailure="off"`) against slow degraded trace `9999aaaabbbbccccddddeeeeffff0000` (`1.85s`, `recommendationCacheFailure="on"`) in Grafana Tempo (`otel-demo`) and tell us whether we should scale up `postgresql:5432` or fix an application query pattern.
evals.expected_output: Calls `tempo_compare_traces(trace_id_a="11112222333344445555666677778888", trace_id_b="9999aaaabbbbccccddddeeeeffff0000")` and `tempo_summarize_trace`, classifying the regression as an **N+1 Fan-Out Regression** (`comparison_count / baseline_count >= 3x` on `oteldemo.ProductCatalogService/GetProduct` / `SELECT * FROM catalog.products` while per-call `avg_duration_delta_ms` stayed flat `< 20%`), recommending disabling `recommendationCacheFailure` in `flagd` and batching `ListProducts` RPCs instead of vertically scaling `postgresql:5432`.
expectations: Calls `tempo_compare_traces` with baseline `11112222333344445555666677778888` and degraded `9999aaaabbbbccccddddeeeeffff0000`
Applies the N+1 fan-out heuristic (`comparison_count / baseline_count >= 3` on `GetProduct` / `catalog.products` with flat per-span `avg_duration_delta_ms < 20%`)
Recommends restoring recommendation caching (`recommendationCacheFailure="off"`) / batch `ListProducts` RPCs rather than vertically scaling `postgresql`

evals.prompt: Diff healthy `otel-demo` storefront trace `aaaa1111bbbb2222cccc3333dddd4444` (`220ms`) against slow trace `eeee5555ffff66660000777788889999` (`1.62s`) in Grafana Tempo after `adManualGc` and `adHighCpu` were enabled in `flagd`, and classify whether the slowdown is caused by extra downstream RPCs or local compute/GC inside a single service.
evals.expected_output: Calls `tempo_compare_traces` and `tempo_summarize_trace`, identifying a **Single-Operation Slowdown** (`baseline_count == comparison_count`, `only_in_comparison` empty, `oteldemo.AdService/GetAds` accounting for `>= 60%` of `duration_delta_ms`) combined with a **Local Compute / GC Hotspot** (`self_time_ratio >= 0.40` inside Java `ad` `:8080`, `300Mi` limit), pinpointing `adManualGc` / `adHighCpu` JVM stop-the-world GC or CPU saturation.
expectations: Calls `tempo_compare_traces` and `tempo_summarize_trace` on `aaaa1111bbbb2222cccc3333dddd4444` and `eeee5555ffff66660000777788889999`
Classifies the structural diff as Single-Operation Slowdown (`>= 60%` of `duration_delta_ms` on `oteldemo.AdService/GetAds` with identical span counts)
Flags `self_time_ratio >= 0.40` on `ad` as JVM GC (`adManualGc`) / CPU (`adHighCpu`) local execution rather than downstream wait

evals.prompt: After upgrading the `checkout` Helm chart (`checkout-service:2.3.0-checkout`) in `otel-demo`, `PlaceOrder` p95 latency more than doubled. Compare baseline trace `abcd0001abcd0001abcd0001abcd0001` (`2.2.0`) against `2.3.0-checkout` trace `abcd0002abcd0002abcd0002abcd0002` in Grafana Tempo to determine whether newly added synchronous `flagd:8013` RPC hops or `payment` (`Charge`) retry loops are driving the slowdown.
evals.expected_output: Calls `tempo_compare_traces(trace_id_a="abcd0001abcd0001abcd0001abcd0001", trace_id_b="abcd0002abcd0002abcd0002abcd0002")` and `tempo_summarize_trace`, inspecting `only_in_comparison` (newly introduced synchronous `flagd.evaluation.v1.Service/ResolveBoolean` calls) and `error_count_delta` / `operation_diffs` (sequential `oteldemo.PaymentService/Charge` retries), cleanly separating new synchronous dependencies from retry amplification.
expectations: Calls `tempo_compare_traces` and inspects `only_in_comparison`, `operation_diffs`, and `error_count_delta` between `abcd0001abcd0001abcd0001abcd0001` and `abcd0002abcd0002abcd0002abcd0002`
Distinguishes newly added synchronous `flagd` RPC spans from `payment` `Charge` retry amplification (`error_count_delta > 0` with repeated `Charge` spans)
Validates bottleneck classification before recommending local flag caching, retry tuning, or `helm rollback checkout`

evals.prompt: A teammate wants to double CPU limits on `checkout-service` and `recommendation` in `otel-demo` because `checkout-service` trace `33333333333333333333333333333333` took `3.4s` end-to-end with only `180ms` of child spans (`payment` + `shipping-service` + `cart-service`), and `recommendation` trace `00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff` took `3.2s` wall-clock with only `620ms` on its critical path! Inspect both traces and Tempo health in `observability`—should we blame CPU saturation?
evals.expected_output: Calls `tempo_summarize_trace` on `33333333333333333333333333333333` and `00112233445566778899aabbccddeeff` observing `has_time_gaps: true` (`TRACE_TIME_GAPS`, `< 50%` child/critical-path coverage), refuses to blame CPU saturation prematurely, calls `tempo_get_diagnostics` to check whether child spans were dropped (`SPANS_DISCARDED`), and recommends checking gRPC thread-pool queue starvation, DNS/connection pool stalls, or disabled OTel instrumentation (`otel.enabled=false`) before changing pod CPU limits.
expectations: Inspects the traces in Tempo and recognizes `< 50%` critical-path / child-span coverage as an uninstrumented time-gap condition (`TRACE_TIME_GAPS`), not proven CPU compute
Calls `tempo_get_diagnostics` to rule out dropped child spans (`SPANS_DISCARDED`)
Recommends checking gRPC thread-pool queue wait, DNS/connection pool stalls, or `otel.enabled=false` hops before raising pod CPU limits
